::: {#def-graph .theorem}
## Graph

An ordered pair $\mathscr{G} = (\mathcal{N}, \psi)$ with node set $\mathcal{N}$ and adjacency function $\psi$. The adjacency function assigns a nonnegative weight to each unordered pair of nodes $(i,j)$.

$$
\mathscr G=(\mathcal N,\psi),\qquad \psi:\mathcal N\times\mathcal N\to \mathbb R_{\ge 0},\qquad \psi(i,j)=\psi(j,i)
$$

Nodes $i,j \in \mathcal{N}$ are connected if and only if $\psi(i,j) > 0$.

The nodes of a graph are [observational units](#def-observational-unit), not random variables, and its edges carry no direction: it represents which units may influence which. The [directed acyclic graph](#def-dag) of an NPSEM is a different object, over variables.
:::
